timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Pipelines build our software. Why do they need security?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Because they hold deploy privileges and secrets. Attackers love pipelines.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Four stages: secure design, secure code, secure pipeline, secure operations.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Threat modeling, IDE plugins, pre-commit hooks, peer review. Catch it before it's written.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Vulnerability scanning in central repos, with actual remediation.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Separate build, test, deploy. Branch protection, PR reviews, scans in CI, IaC scanning.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Environment-based approvals for production. And sign and verify artifacts.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: No. Workload identity federation instead. Nothing to steal.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Verify every action, least privilege for service identities, isolate environments.
